   **Bugs and stability.**
      11 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 27, 2026 - Aug 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Franc O._, Aug 6, 2026, 1/5: "The previously good UI has become atrocious. But even more problematic is that the license doesn’t work and nor does the automatic backup to Google Drive. In short, it is currently unusable."
            2. _HannahWust_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "Do not buy! I always have bugs like folders being shown empty, or import not working."
            3. _IN7484_, Jul 21, 2026, 1/5: "This app used to be so good before a couple of updates and then ever since it’s like the developer are going out of their way to make this app worse and worse after each update. The tool bar is impossible to customise and it’s a headache to use. I have to click five things to access one feature which makes me loose my attention. The searching tool used to highlight the word now it doesn’t anymore which such a stupid thing to take away! The whole app is just insanely glitchy and annoying. When I leave the app it automatically closes the note books I had open which is the dumbest thing to add. Another pain in the bum is when I import a pdf in one of my notebooks it asks me to open it in a different file by default and I have to manually change it to opening it in the current notebook… it used to be the other way around which made more sense but OFC they had to change it because they hate having a functional app. There are so many other things that got worse instead of better after updating. It’s like they lobotomised this godforsaken app. I hate it.
